title: 2 From what euils he ſaueth vs.

segments.text: HE deliuereth vs from all, euils of all both crime, and paine, moſt fullie and perfectly. Math 1.21. He ſhal ſaue his people from their ſinnes. 1. Iohn. 1.7. The bloud of Ieſus Chriſt clenſeth vs from all ſinne, that is, that it may not bee imputed vnto vs, and that it may not raigne in vs, but bee aboliſhed, and ſo wee at length leaue off to ſinne. Wherefore alſo hee deliuereth vs from all paine, and puniſhment. For the cauſe being taken away, which is ſinne, the effect is taken away, which is puniſhment. Rom. 8.1. Now then there is no condemnation to them that are in Chriſt Ieſus. Iohn. 10.28. I giue vnto them eternall life. The ſaluation then, which this our Sauiour Ieſus Chriſt bringeth vs, is righteouſnes and life euerlaſting. Dan 9 24. Seuentie weeks are determined to finiſh the wickednes, and to ſeale vp the ſinnes. and to reconcile the iniquitie, and to bring in euerlaſting righteouſnes. 1. Cor. 1.30. He is made vnto vs wiſedome, righteouſnes, ſanctification, and redemption.
